project.name: gh-pages-showcase
project.tagline: A drop-in static site template for GitHub Pages. Copy four files, fill in a JSON, push. Get a polished project page with zero build step.

hero.code:
# from inside any repo you want to add Pages to
mkdir -p docs
cp -r /path/to/gh-pages-showcase/template/. ./docs/
mv ./docs/showcase.example.json ./docs/showcase.json
$EDITOR ./docs/showcase.json
git add docs/ && git commit -m 'Add showcase site' && git push

# enable Pages: Settings → Pages → branch master, folder /docs

highlights.title: Zero build step
highlights.description: Three static files (index.html / style.css / main.js) plus a JSON config. No npm, no bundler, no toolchain. Edit, push, refresh.

highlights.title: Sections that hide themselves
highlights.description: Provide a hero image, get a hero section. Skip it, the section disappears. Same for highlights, quickstart, screenshots, and links.

highlights.title: Themable via CSS variables
highlights.description: Default palette is dark with a sandstone accent. Override --bg, --accent, --link on :root in a sibling theme.css and you're done.

highlights.title: Per-repo data, shared template
highlights.description: Only showcase.json is project-specific. The other three files never need editing per-repo, so upstream improvements re-copy cleanly.

highlights.title: Pairs with gh-pages-multiplexer
highlights.description: Every versioned deploy gets the same template applied to its showcase.json. Visitors land on the canonical entrypoint; the multiplexer routes.

highlights.title: Self-hosting
highlights.description: This page is itself a gh-pages-showcase site, deployed from the repo's own /docs/. The live thing IS the documentation.

quickstart.code:
# 1. Drop the template into your repo
mkdir -p docs
curl -sSL https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-showcase/archive/master.tar.gz \
  | tar -xz --strip=2 -C docs gh-pages-showcase-master/template/

# 2. Copy the example to start editing
mv docs/showcase.example.json docs/showcase.json

# 3. Edit docs/showcase.json — only project.name and project.tagline are required

# 4. Commit and enable Pages (Settings → Pages → branch master, folder /docs)
git add docs && git commit -m 'Add showcase site' && git push
